metadata.task: Phase 9 Operational Gap Closure (Tasks A1 - A7)
metadata.status: All Operational Gaps Successfully Closed & Verified
metadata.production_approval_status: WITHHELD (Pending Phase 10 Model API & External Pre-Deployment Gates)

gap_1_universal_cma_suppression.description: Universal CMA outreach suppression rule enforced before module routing across all 7 courses.

gap_2_complete_decision_audit_logging.description: Immutable DecisionAuditRecord captures model name, model version, pipeline version, feature hash, threshold, and suppression reason.

gap_3_privacy_safe_pseudonymization.description: Keyed HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymization replaces raw student IDs using environment secret.
gap_3_privacy_safe_pseudonymization.pseudonymous_data_notice: Keyed HMAC-SHA256 constitutes pseudonymous personal data under GDPR Art. 4(5) / FERPA, not anonymous data.

gap_4_threshold_aware_incident_review.description: Threshold-aware incident review enforces 0.10 on GGG TMAs, 0.20 on other TMAs, excludes CMAs, and avoids model defect bias.

gap_5_telemetry_gradebook_interfaces.description: Defined explicit ingestion interfaces distinguishing event from ingestion timestamps, enforcing cutoffs, and specifying production gradebook API.

gap_6_shadow_mode_safety_locks.description: Hard-coded safety lock prevents automated student messaging; monitoring gates track missingness, latency, and drift.

remaining_external_dependencies: Institutional counseling leadership sign-off on 7,130 TMA alert volume and staffing allocation.
LMS clickstream ingestion latency verification confirming sub-24h event availability.
Live SIS/LMS gradebook release event API webhook integration.
Formal secret key provisioning via enterprise key management (KMS / HashiCorp Vault).
